label: Bible Study
prompt: Be ye _____ of me, even as I also am of Christ.
verse: Be ye followers of me, even as I also am of Christ.
note: Paul's bold invitation — copy me, as I copy Christ.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: Cast not away therefore your _____, which hath great recompence of reward.
verse: Cast not away therefore your confidence, which hath great recompence of reward.
note: Don't toss your confidence overboard — the writer says it comes with a great reward attached.

label: Sunday School
prompt: The mountains _____ like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
verse: The mountains skipped like rams, and the little hills like lambs.
note: When Israel came out of Egypt, the psalmist says the mountains skipped like rams and the hills like lambs.

label: Deep Water
prompt: And Enoch _____ with God: and he was not; for God took him.
verse: And Enoch walked with God: and he was not; for God took him.
note: Enoch never died — just walked with God until one day he walked right on home.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: For our light _____, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
verse: For our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory;
note: Paul's scales: a 'light affliction' for a moment versus 'an eternal weight of glory' — no contest.
